notes: DocumentCloud uploads of Applicants' Record vols 4, 5 and 6 (T-121-22): multi mode over page ranges of the three volumes (affidavit vol 4 pp 23-33; exhibits from each typed cover to the page before the next, per the record index). Labels A1-A13, B1-B15, C1-C14, D1-D3, E, F do not match split.py's label pattern, so every cover is named with --covers (all typed 'This is Exhibit "X" referred to in the affidavit of Elizabeth Gabel'). Several exhibits are excerpts (C1-C7, C9-C11, per the affidavit). C2's file is the February 2002 IRED printed in the 2006 decision document. Stray margin letters (A.-F.) sit at the top of affidavit pages.
